title: The daily batch and the Founder's emailed answers (Piece 2, P2-5)
why: Jason's Piece 2 (decisions/0179 rule 1; handoffs/piece2-team.md §7; Q3 A, 2026-11-25): the session manager's daily batch (releases/batch.json, carried in gauges.json by gauges.py) shown at the top of the Work queue, only on its own day, with the Tier 3 decisions waiting first; Approve the batch for the Founder's own login only (Access::isFounder), recorded once for the day and carried by report() to the session manager; the Founder's emailed Tier 3 answers (gauge-pickups.json's answers) applied once, only to a Resolution waiting for him, as "Jason (by email, recorded by the session manager)", with History.

changes.what: Today's batch at the top of the Work queue: the Tier 3 decisions waiting first, each release's line, Approve the batch (the Founder's), or No batch from the session manager today
The Founder's emailed answers put on their Resolution tickets once, kept in the History
FAQ: What is Today's batch at the top of the Work queue?

rollback: Proved on the bench (tools/team-tests/rollback.sh, 2026-11-25): the zip laid over the live mirror (Sync 18:29 UTC, with #289), then Roll back as the site does it (each file put back from live): the files match live byte for byte, every PHP file parses, and the Work queue's own suites (84, 44, 32) and the runner's (runner.cjs 44) pass on the rolled-back code. No migration: nothing left behind.

checks.founder_only: Approve the batch is greyed for anyone but Access::isFounder(); api.php's qbatch asks isFounder() first (tickets.php, batch.php, batch.cjs).
checks.only_today: A batch shows only on its own UTC date; otherwise "No batch from the session manager today" (batch.php, batch.cjs).
checks.answers_once: Emailed answers apply once, only to a Resolution waiting for the Founder, as "Jason (by email, recorded by the session manager)", with History and its precedent ticket; one still being briefed, an unknown id or a bad answer is ignored (batch.php).
